subject: Trail plans and the thing I keep forgetting
text:
Morning,

I got distracted by the trail photos again. The loop by the reservoir looks muddy, but the ridge route might be clear if it dries out. I was hoping to sneak in six miles before the next work push. My shoes are still by the door, so that says something.

Also, the tracker isn't done. I meant to log the supplier numbers yesterday, then the forecast sheet opened and my attention wandered. I'll finish it after lunch, assuming I don't start researching camp stoves again. If you already moved the tabs, just tell me which one is stale.

Anyway, if you want a weekend rec, I have two maps and too many opinions. Pick one, and I'll stop spiraling.
